task: Predict histologic grade in endometrial carcinoma. Classes: Low vs. High. Distinguishing H&E features include the degree of gland formation versus solid growth, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, and tumor necrosis.

classes.0: Low-grade tumor with predominant gland formation, relatively uniform nuclei, and limited mitotic activity.
classes.1: High-grade tumor with increased solid architecture, marked nuclear atypia, brisk mitoses, and often necrosis.
